$comment: Conformance corpus for IntentSpec anchor resolution. The schema's pattern check proves an anchor is well-formed; these cases pin what happens when a well-formed anchor points at a section that does not exist. Both the browser validator on intentspec.org and validate-intentspec-action run their own implementation against this file, so the two can never drift apart silently. Every spec here is schema-valid on purpose: anchor resolution only runs after the shape check passes.

cases.name: every anchor kind resolves, including the last valid index
a spec with no evidence has nothing to resolve
evidence without anchors is left alone
an outcome index past the end does not resolve
expectedErrors: /evidence/0/anchors "outcome:3" does not resolve: this spec has 1 outcome entry

cases.name: anchoring userGoal in a spec that has none does not resolve
expectedErrors: /evidence/0/anchors "userGoal" targets a field that is not present in this spec

cases.name: sections that are absent entirely count as zero entries
expectedErrors: /evidence/0/anchors "edgeCase:0" does not resolve: this spec has 0 edgeCase entries
/evidence/0/anchors "constraint:0" does not resolve: this spec has 0 constraint entries
/evidence/0/anchors "healthMetric:0" does not resolve: this spec has 0 healthMetric entries

cases.name: the error names the evidence item it came from
expectedErrors: /evidence/1/anchors "outcome:5" does not resolve: this spec has 1 outcome entry
